cards.gloss_cn: 姿势、姿态;(局面的)状态、处境
cards.gloss_en: a bodily position; also the state of affairs
cards.ex_en: She sat up straight to keep a good posture.
cards.ex_cn: 她坐直身子以保持良好姿势。

cards.gloss_en: a wall or structure built for defence
cards.ex_en: Soldiers built a fortification around the town.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们在城镇周围修建了防御工事。

cards.gloss_en: the feeling of being grateful
cards.ex_en: She felt deep thankfulness for their help.
cards.ex_cn: 她对他们的帮助心怀深深的感激。

cards.gloss_en: a shady, leafy shelter or retreat
cards.ex_en: We rested in a cool bower under the trees.
cards.ex_cn: 我们在树下凉爽的荫棚里休息。

cards.gloss_cn: 前景、指望;眼前所见的景象、视野
cards.gloss_en: a hope or outlook; also the view or scene before one
cards.ex_en: The job offers a bright prospect for the future.
cards.ex_cn: 这份工作有着光明的前景。

cards.gloss_en: an old unit of distance, about three miles
cards.ex_en: The ship was still a league from the coast.
cards.ex_cn: 船离海岸还有一里格远。

cards.gloss_en: made of baked clay or earth
cards.ex_en: She kept water in an earthen pot.
cards.ex_cn: 她把水装在陶罐里。

cards.gloss_en: to keep something safe or in good condition
cards.ex_en: Salt helps to preserve meat.
cards.ex_cn: 盐有助于保存肉类。

cards.gloss_en: in contrast, while on the other hand
cards.ex_en: He likes tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
cards.ex_cn: 他喜欢茶,而她更爱咖啡。

cards.gloss_en: great suffering or distress
cards.ex_en: Illness was a heavy affliction for the old man.
cards.ex_cn: 疾病是这位老人沉重的苦难。

cards.gloss_en: dried grapes
cards.ex_en: I put some raisins in the cake.
cards.ex_cn: 我在蛋糕里放了些葡萄干。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being needed or unavoidable
cards.ex_en: Water is a necessity for all life.
cards.ex_cn: 水是一切生命的必需品。

cards.gloss_en: very frightening or terrible
cards.ex_en: A frightful storm hit the village at night.
cards.ex_cn: 夜里一场可怕的暴风雨袭击了村庄。

cards.gloss_en: frightened; filled with fear
cards.ex_en: The frighted horse ran across the field.
cards.ex_cn: 受惊的马奔过田野。

cards.gloss_en: opposite in direction; unfavourable
cards.ex_en: The wind was contrary, so the boat went slowly.
cards.ex_cn: 风向不顺,船走得很慢。

cards.gloss_en: to become less strong; die down
cards.ex_en: By morning the storm began to abate.
cards.ex_cn: 到早晨风暴开始减弱。

cards.gloss_en: greatest possible in degree or amount
cards.ex_en: He ran with the utmost speed to catch the bus.
cards.ex_cn: 他以最快的速度去赶公交车。

cards.gloss_en: a master or protector who supports someone
cards.ex_en: The young artist thanked his patron.
cards.ex_cn: 年轻的画家感谢他的资助人。

cards.gloss_en: a fenced or walled-in area of land
cards.ex_en: The sheep grazed inside a small enclosure.
cards.ex_cn: 羊群在一小块围场里吃草。

cards.gloss_en: a circular movement of water; whirlpool
cards.ex_en: Leaves spun round in the eddy of the river.
cards.ex_cn: 树叶在河水的漩涡里打转。

cards.gloss_en: the basic things one needs
cards.ex_en: He packed only the necessaries for the trip.
cards.ex_cn: 他只带了旅途的必需品。

cards.gloss_en: a danger or risk
cards.ex_en: Wet roads are a hazard to drivers.
cards.ex_cn: 湿滑的路面对司机是一种危险。

cards.gloss_en: distance north or south of the equator
cards.ex_en: The island lies at a low latitude near the equator.
cards.ex_cn: 这座岛位于靠近赤道的低纬度。

cards.gloss_en: dared (old form of dare)
cards.ex_en: No one durst speak to the angry king.
cards.ex_cn: 没人敢对愤怒的国王说话。

cards.gloss_en: posts driven into the ground for support
cards.ex_en: The bridge stood on tall wooden piles.
cards.ex_cn: 桥立在高高的木桩上。

cards.gloss_en: held an idea or thought in the mind
cards.ex_en: She entertained no doubt about her plan.
cards.ex_cn: 她对自己的计划毫不怀疑。

cards.gloss_en: wood used for building
cards.ex_en: They cut timber to build the house.
cards.ex_cn: 他们砍伐木材来盖房子。

cards.gloss_en: kept safe or in good condition
cards.ex_en: The ice preserved the fresh fish for days.
cards.ex_cn: 冰把鲜鱼保存了好几天。

cards.gloss_en: to plant seeds in the ground
cards.ex_en: Farmers sow seeds in the spring.
cards.ex_cn: 农民在春天播种。

cards.gloss_en: planted seeds in the ground
cards.ex_en: He sowed the wheat in the wide field.
cards.ex_cn: 他在宽阔的田里播下小麦。

cards.gloss_en: in the past; before now
cards.ex_en: This building was formerly a school.
cards.ex_cn: 这栋楼从前是一所学校。

cards.gloss_en: extremely; very
cards.ex_en: The night was exceeding cold on the hill.
cards.ex_cn: 山上的夜晚极其寒冷。

cards.gloss_en: the main body of land, not an island
cards.ex_en: A ferry carries people to the mainland.
cards.ex_cn: 渡船把人们送到大陆。

cards.gloss_en: to eat quickly and hungrily
cards.ex_en: The hungry wolf will devour the meat.
cards.ex_cn: 饥饿的狼会把肉吞食掉。

cards.gloss_en: the rising of the tide
cards.ex_en: The boat drifted in on the rising flood.
cards.ex_cn: 小船随着上涨的潮水漂了进来。

cards.gloss_en: savage and uncivilised
cards.ex_en: The travellers feared the barbarous coast.
cards.ex_cn: 旅人们害怕那片野蛮的海岸。

cards.gloss_en: shouted loudly to attract attention
cards.ex_en: He hallooed loudly to call the dog back.
cards.ex_cn: 他大声呼喊把狗叫回来。

cards.gloss_en: people trusted to manage money or property
cards.ex_en: The trustees kept the money safe for the child.
cards.ex_cn: 受托人为孩子妥善保管这笔钱。

suspect.suggest: 增补引申义“(处境、局面的)状态、情形”

suspect.ctx: many times upon the prospect of land which I had seen from the other...
suspect.issue: 现释义“前景、指望”覆盖抽象义;但书中亦作具体“(眺望所见的)景象、远景”,如 prospect of land,用“前景”读不顺
suspect.suggest: 增补具体义“(眼前所见的)景象、远景”
